subject.title: [Feature]: Support arbitrary workspace files in bootstrap context injection

question: Should `bootstrap-extra-files` accept explicitly configured custom-basename workspace files, or should it remain limited to the recognized bootstrap filenames?
rationale: The change expands deterministic system-prompt context and the hook configuration contract, which is a product/security boundary choice rather than a mechanical bug fix.

options.title: Approve guarded custom files
options.body: Allow custom-basename files through the existing hook path after the linked PR or a replacement preserves path containment, budgets, session filtering, and documentation.

options.title: Keep recognized basenames only
options.body: Reject arbitrary workspace-file injection and close or redirect custom-file requests to narrower first-class filename or workspace-convention proposals.

options.title: Defer to broader context design
options.body: Document existing composition patterns and wait for a more general context API before expanding bootstrap-extra-files.

recommendation.title: Approve guarded custom files
recommendation.body: Allow custom-basename files through the existing hook path after the linked PR or a replacement preserves path containment, budgets, session filtering, and documentation.

likelyOwner.reason: He merged the original bootstrap-extra-files feature and has recent current-line history in the workspace bootstrap path.
